title: ## The C2 table at the discriminants its rule would choose: none -- every class-number-2 field’s least negative index at -2 or -1/2, the halt proved; the table over h = 3, 4, 5 written and checked, two predictions registered (n0 = 80 at -31, 224 at -55); the offset’s post hoc rows, H-OFFSET refuted on its own first rows, and 0 new pairs registered; the surgery carried; the frozen line’s statements quoted, its drafts for the release sitting; 6 of 6 wave 1 kernels build at their own pins, one with a sorry; the federation pin closed
